Now, the cause: In `RelatedManager` (reverse many-to-one) and `ManyRelatedManager`, the classes are created via `create_forward_many_to_one_manager` / `create_reverse_many_to_one_manager` which take a `superclass` (the manager class, e.g. `Manager`).
